description: Instead of "how do we succeed?" ask "how could we fail?" Then avoid those paths.
output_pattern: failure modes → inverted strategy → safer plan
when_to_use: When a plan feels too optimistic

description: Drill from symptom to root cause by asking "why?" five times. Each answer becomes the next "why".
output_pattern: symptom → causes (5 levels deep) → root cause
when_to_use: Debugging or RCA on a decision
